answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique forum moderator tenure. It rests on a forum moderated with a public log for three years, which gives every honest agent a nectar that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a forum moderated with a public log for three years takes calendar time as well as money — and the mesa is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the umber is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
